text:
Priya: Heads up 00k ARR health provider asking for an air-gapped POC. They want details on delivery options (USB vs. courier), upgrade cadence, SBOM, and pricing uplift. Can we sketch answers + blockers?

Ben: Quick check 0: do they require signed bundles with HSM-backed keys or is a signed tarball enough?

Amir: They want HSM attestation and supply-chain proof. Also CVE SLA of 30 days for critical fixes.

Claire: We can do HSM-signed manifests and provide SBOM JSON. For CVE workflow: monthly security minibundles (recommended) and emergency hotfixes within 7 days if critical. Hotfixes delivered as signed minibundles.

Priya: Media: they asked if we can ship encrypted USB + checksum and a verification script.

Packager: Yes. Full image ~10-14GB; minibundles <200MB. For strict transport, we shard into 500MB parts and provide sha256 manifest and a small reassembly tool.

Ben: Good. What about licensing activation offline?

Amir: We generate activation tokens (signed) that they import via CLI. Add offline activation steps to runbook.

LegalBot: On SBOM/key provenance Q: Proposed answer: "We provide SBOM, signer certificate chain, and HSM attestation. Private key never leaves FIPS 140-2 HSM; audit logs available under NDA."

Claire: Ops ETA: 2 business days to produce initial minibundle + signed manifest; 5 business days for full offline runbook and chunk testing. No canned SKU for chunking 1; bill as PS (estimate 82 hrs).

Priya: Pricing note: add one-time packaging fee + 1.2x support multiplier for concierge staging for first quarter. Kevin, can you add line items?

Ben: I'll add packaging, chunking PS hours, emergency hotfix premium, and offline activation aid.

Priya: Blockers? Any security/legal issues before we send to customer?

LegalBot: Need to confirm export controls and whether SBOM contains any restricted components. Also redact audit logs before sharing.

Amir: Compliance says they need signed manifest + sample reassembly commands for offline verification. Will validate once we share.

Priya: Plan: Ben to draft quote and packaging line items; Claire to produce runbook and chunker script; LegalBot to craft SBOM/key provenance wording. Reply to customer by EOD tomorrow.

Packager: I'll upload a sample chunk manifest to drive and link in the reply.

Priya: Thanks all. This should be straightforward.
